goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09): back to 30M chars / bs96. The iter-19 10M/384 committed-budget probe (w7to9wg0, hardy-aardvark-18) was NON-CONVERGENT: 2.2631 BPC @ E40 vs 1.6621 at 30M/96 (~12x fewer steps/epoch). The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept.

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~35 min (2108.6s) to 1.6621 BPC @ E40 at re-locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget; crossed old best 1.8833 by E10 (~8.5 min)
current_best.notes: Iter-22 (kernel v35, run lt4fpm5d usual-blaze-26): NEW BEST 1.6621 BPC via the token-dec scaling lever (token_dec 8L/1024 + token_qk_norm). Token-dec lever is monotonic and winning: 3L/256:1.876 -> 4L/384:1.848 -> 5L/512:1.794 -> 6L/768:1.719 -> 7L/896:1.705 -> 7L/896+qk:1.6826 -> 8L/1024+qk:1.6621. Budget RE-LOCKED to 30M/96 (the 10M/384 committed budget probe w7to9wg0 was non-convergent at 2.2631 BPC, ~12x fewer steps/epoch). Chunk-dec 12L/2560 scale-up REGRESSED (1.8483->1.8749) -> reverted to 8L/2048. Prior: 1.8833 (iter-15/v23, bsggqgae) -> 1.9049 (bigram regression, reverted) -> v25 QK-norm build ERROR -> v26 QK-norm fix (mask broadcast) -> iter-19 v27 committed-budget first run -> iter-20..24 token-dec scaling probe series (v30 chunk 12L revert, v33 7L/896, v34 token_qk_norm, v35 8L/1024).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.
